name: Wakeari Musume no Joyuu Shigan ~Ojou-san, Kuru Toko Machigatte Imasen ka?~
original_name: 訳アリ娘の女優志願 ～お嬢さん、来るとこ間違っていませんか？～
source:
I'm the president and director of an adult video production company. My brand specializes in orgies and has developed a cult following among a niche audience.

I'd been thinking it was time to bring in a good new actress when a prospective talent came in for an interview. Her name was Aoibashi Hazuki - twenty years old, a virgin, and beautiful on top of it. She was exactly the kind of girl I’d have begged to join the company.

But the moment I saw her resume, I knew something was off. She had a story, desperately needed money, and had come here fully aware of what that meant.

Just to be safe, I suggested trying a major agency instead. Her answer caught me off guard:

"At a place full of beautiful women, I'd just get lost in the crowd."

She'd clearly thought this through. If she'd chosen this path of her own free will, then I had to respect her resolve. So I decided to give her a "simple audition test".

[Translated from the [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt295/apt295.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
我是一家成人影片制作公司的社长兼导演。我旗下的厂牌主打群交题材，在小众受众圈子里积累了一批狂热的死忠拥趸。

就在我盘算着是时候物色一位优秀新人女优的时候，一名志愿入行的女孩上门参加面试了。她名叫葵桥叶月——芳龄二十，是个处女，而且容貌出众，简直就是那种值得我跪下来求她签约的极品女孩。

然而刚一看到她的简历，我就知道事情没那么简单。她是个有故事的人，急需用钱，而且是在完全清楚我们公司底细的前提下主动找上门来的。

稳妥起见，我劝她不妨去试试大型正规事务所，可她的回答却让我大出意料：

“要是去了美女如云的地方，我肯定只会被埋没在人群里。”

她显然已经深思熟虑过了。既然这是她凭自己意愿选定的道路，那我也必须尊重她的觉悟。于是，我决定对她进行一场“简单的试镜测试”。
